en.title: X-Men Assemble! D23 Reveals 7 New Mutant Stars for 2028 Film
en.summary: Marvel Studios just dropped a bombshell at D23 2026, announcing the core cast for its brand-new X-Men film set to hit theaters in May 2028. The highly anticipated project marks a significant new chapter for the iconic mutant team on the big screen.
en.body:
The X-Men are officially back in the Marvel Studios fold, and the future looks incredibly bright. At D23 2026, Marvel Studios chief Kevin Feige took to the stage to unveil the ensemble cast for the upcoming X-Men film, slated for a May 2028 release. This marks the first major cinematic outing for the mutants since the original Fox franchise concluded, and the excitement is palpable.

The newly announced cast includes a vibrant mix of rising stars and familiar faces. **Sadie Sink** will portray the powerful psychic **Jean Grey**, while **Kit Connor** steps into the role of the optic-blasting leader, **Cyclops**. **Christopher Abbott** is set to embody the brilliant and burdened **Professor X**, and **Inde Navarrette** will bring **Rogue** to life. Rounding out the core group are **Maya Boyd** as the weather-wielding **Storm**, **Samara Weaving** in a yet-to-be-revealed role, and the formidable **Adam Driver**, who is confirmed to play the villainous **Mr. Sinister**. This diverse lineup promises a fresh perspective on these legendary characters.

> "It is so wonderful to be here and to finally be able to talk about this character after months of speculation," Sink told the crowd at D23. "We’re here to talk about the X-Men. Should we meet some more of the cast?"

This announcement is more than just a casting reveal; it's the dawn of a new era for the X-Men in cinema. For years, fans have speculated about when and how Marvel Studios would integrate these beloved mutants into the MCU. The inclusion of **Mr. Sinister** as a key villain, portrayed by **Adam Driver**, suggests a story that could delve into complex genetic themes and the darker side of mutant existence, echoing the spirit of the comics. The reception online has been a whirlwind of anticipation, with fans dissecting every casting choice and speculating about the narrative direction. The stakes are high, as this film needs to not only satisfy long-time devotees but also introduce the X-Men to a new generation of moviegoers.

## A New Generation of Mutants

The selection of actors like **Sadie Sink** and **Kit Connor** signifies Marvel's commitment to bringing fresh energy to the franchise. Sink, fresh off her acclaimed performances, is perfectly poised to embody the emotional depth of **Jean Grey**. Connor, known for his captivating screen presence, is an inspired choice for **Cyclops**, a character often defined by his stoicism and leadership. The casting of **Christopher Abbott** as **Professor X** hints at a more complex, perhaps morally ambiguous, portrayal of the iconic telepath. Meanwhile, **Maya Boyd**'s turn as **Storm** and **Inde Navarrette** as **Rogue** promise dynamic performances that honor the characters' established powers and personalities. The presence of **Adam Driver** as **Mr. Sinister** is a major coup, bringing a gravity to the villain that promises a truly menacing antagonist.

## What's Next

With the cast now officially revealed, the focus shifts to the production and marketing leading up to the May 2028 release. Fans can expect more details about the specific roles of **Samara Weaving** and other supporting characters, as well as insights into the film's plot and its place within the larger Marvel Cinematic Universe, to emerge in the coming months. The journey of these new X-Men has just begun.

content_raw: It's a new dawn for X-Men . 63 years into the franchise, spanning everything from its first comic book to the latest X-Men '97 , the series is entering a new generation with its upcoming 2028 X-Men film . It will be the first major X-Men movie since the third installment of the original 20th Century Fox series, 2006's X-Men: The Last Stand . Since then, multiple X-Men -adjacent movies have been released, with some, like X-Men: Apocalypse , receiving a lukewarm reception, while others, such as Logan , were widely celebrated.
